obligations.description: The controller has phases IDLE, ACCESS, WAIT_ACK and RESPONSE. io_req_ready is high exactly in IDLE, io_mem_access_valid exactly in ACCESS, and io_resp_valid exactly in RESPONSE for a returning command. At a rising edge, IDLE accepts io_req_valid and enters ACCESS; ACCESS enters WAIT_ACK only when io_mem_access_ready is high; WAIT_ACK enters RESPONSE only when io_mem_ack_valid is high. RESPONSE returns to IDLE on io_resp_ready for returning commands, or unconditionally for nonreturning commands. Otherwise the phase holds. There is no same-edge bypass, second outstanding transaction or pending-request buffer. Request valid and payload while busy do not replace the accepted request. Acknowledgments outside WAIT_ACK have no effect, including an acknowledgment on the ACCESS acceptance edge. Response backpressure preserves a returning response and blocks new requests.
obligations.setup: Apply a reset edge, then establish the named reachable phase and the captured request/W history independently using native handshakes. Never accept command7 into a busy nonreset history.
obligations.stimulus: Apply reset at a rising edge. For every permitted command transact through request acceptance, two ACCESS stalled cycles, access fire, two WAIT_ACK delay cycles, ack acceptance, two RESPONSE stalled cycles for returning commands and completion. Drive req_valid and unrelated randomized payload throughout busy phases. Pulse ack in IDLE after completion and on explicit busy non-WAIT phases; show the pulse is ignored and a later valid ack is needed. Run returning/nonreturning commands with both response-ready values.

obligations.description: A source is always decimal9. A size is the captured two-bit mem_size zero extended to four bits. A address is captured request address bits32:0; bits39:33 are discarded. For each of the16 byte lanes, mask bit lane is one exactly when floor(lane/2^size) equals floor(captured_address[3:0]/2^size). Thus the mask selects the aligned size block containing the low address nibble, even for an unaligned address. The current live request cannot alter these captured-field functions. After request capture these access fields are combinationally defined even when A valid is low, and remain stable throughout ACCESS backpressure.

obligations.description: At a rising edge in WAIT_ACK with ack valid and a returning command, capture the selected64-bit half of the128-bit ack: lower half when captured address bit3 is zero, upper half otherwise. Nonreturning acknowledgments do not update this stored word. From the stored word W select U32 as W bits63:32 when address bit2 is one, otherwise bits31:0; select U16 as U32 bits31:16 when bit1 is one, otherwise bits15:0; select U8 as U16 bits15:8 when bit0 is one, otherwise bits7:0. Response data is sign/zero extended U8 for size0; for size1 it is {48 sign bits,U16[15:8],U8}; for size2 {32 sign bits,U32[31:16],U16[15:8],U8}; for size3 {W[63:32],U32[31:16],U16[15:8],U8}. Sign bits are the selected byte/half/word high bit AND captured mem_signed. These expressions intentionally cover all unaligned low addresses. Before the first returning acknowledgment W-derived bits are unspecified; afterward they remain defined during invalid phases and reset and may be reinterpreted by a later captured request.

obligations.description: Known binary inputs are admitted. Apply a rising edge with active-high reset to initialize the phase. Reset has priority over every phase transition and sets IDLE; a short pulse entirely between rising edges does not change phase. Reset does not asynchronously gate outputs or clear captured request/W registers. Capture of an idle valid request still occurs on a reset edge. A returning acknowledgment in pre-edge WAIT_ACK still updates W on a reset edge, while phase resets and the pending response is abandoned. Capturing command7 while reset keeps IDLE is permitted, but replace it with a permitted command before any nonreset edge in a busy phase: a nonreset busy phase carrying command7 terminates simulation. No alignment restriction, external TileLink semantics or command-name assumptions are imposed. All unsigned native fields retain their exact width. Inputs may change while busy, including ack pulses outside WAIT_ACK; their ignored behavior is part of the contract.

Include reset coincident with a returning WAIT_ACK acknowledgment to verify W capture survives while phase resets.
